meta_title: Lyric Studio — Lyric videos & visualizers in your browser
meta_description: Make synced lyric videos, audio visualizers and photo montages in your browser. No upload, no editor, free to start. Built for indie musicians.
hero_subhead: Synced lyrics, audio visualizers and photo montages — exported in minutes. No editor, no upload, free to start.
hero_privacy: Runs entirely in your browser — your unreleased track never leaves your device.
how_step1_title: Paste lyrics or drop your song
how_step1_desc: Bring timestamped lyrics, or just your audio file — everything stays on your device.
how_step2_title: Pick a style, format and colours
how_step2_desc: Lyric card, visualizer or montage. Choose 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1.
how_step3_desc: Render an MP4/WebM in your browser and upload it anywhere.
tools_lyric_desc: Word-perfect, beat-synced lyrics over your art.
tools_visualizer_desc: Six reactive styles that move with your music.
tools_montage_desc: Turn a folder of photos into a timed slideshow.
formats_subhead: Export the exact aspect ratio each platform wants — or set a custom size.
pricing_subhead: Free to start. Pay once for lifetime Pro — no subscription.
reserve_supporting: Lock in lifetime access at the early price. Pro features roll out over the coming weeks — founders get them all.
reserve_helper: No charge today. We'll email you when Founder access opens.
reserve_success_body: Your $24 early price is reserved. We'll email you when Founder access opens.
reserve_err_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
reserve_err_unreachable: Could not reach our list. Tap below to reserve by email instead.
faq_q1: Does my audio or images get uploaded?
faq_a1: No. Everything runs in your browser — your files never leave your device.
faq_q2: What do I get with Founder access?
faq_a2: Lifetime: 1080p exports, no watermark, every format and visualizer style, plus all future Pro features — one payment, no subscription.
faq_a3: No. You're reserving the $24 early price. We'll email you a checkout link when Founder access opens.
faq_a5: Chrome or Edge give the most reliable video export.
footer_tagline: Lyric Studio — made for indie artists.
